title: Thai Crumble Nostalgic Delight
description: A sweet and crunchy dessert that combines the nostalgia of a classic crumble with the exotic flavors of Thailand.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the Thai Red Rice and Nostalgic Crumble Mix.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted Coconut Oil and Thai Tea Syrup.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until a crumbly mixture forms.
Press the mixture into a 9x9 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and drizzle with the Flavorful Vanilla Extract.
